name: dev-flows
description: Dev workflow commands for any repository: configure the repo's integrations, file issues from planning notes, evaluate a branch or PR for shippability, sync a branch with its PR and issue, take a finished branch to a ready, green PR, land it, run a worktree's dev server and preview a branch's work in a browser, prototype a UI as an HTML mockup, and start work on issues in workspaces with a coding agent on each. Needs dev-flows-base installed too.

interface.shortDescription: Sync, ready, land, and start work on any repo
